title: RecommendationSystem RecSysV2LaunchEvaluation

stats.done_summary: Completed RecSys-v2 Launch Evaluation research task. Analyzed offline evaluation metrics (n=200,000 test set) and online A/B test results (14-day, 10% traffic per arm). Generated 4 visualization figures and comprehensive report. Key finding: DO NOT LAUNCH RecSys-v2 due to 187% increase in complaint rate, 50.6% coverage reduction, and 8.1% D7 retention decline, despite improvements in CTR (+16.2%), Precision@10 (+12.5%), and NDCG@10 (+9.6%). Report saved to report/report.md with all figures in report/images/.
